\[
\text{New Length} = \left( \frac{3}{5} \right) \times \text{Initial Length}
\]

\[
\text{New Length} = \left( \frac{3}{5} \right) \times 30 = 18 \text{ cm}
\]

3. Find out how many units are left after applying the reduction ratio by multiplying the number of remaining units (3 parts) by the length per unit (3.75 cm * 3 = 11.25 cm).

\[ \text{New Length} = \left(\frac{\text{Initial Length}}{\text{Total Ratio Units}}\right) \times (\text{Remaining Ratio Units}) \]
